"""Archived in the formal JSON record; run only after oracle and builds finish."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

scratch, output = map(Path, sys.argv[1:3])
oracles = {revision: json.loads((scratch / f"{revision}-oracle.json").read_text())
           for revision in ["baseline", "candidate"]}
for a, b in zip(oracles["baseline"]["cases"], oracles["candidate"]["cases"], strict=True):
    assert (a["kind"], a["words"], a["oracle"]) == (b["kind"], b["words"], b["oracle"])
raw = []
for pair in range(5):
    order = ["baseline", "candidate"] if pair % 2 == 0 else ["candidate", "baseline"]
    for revision in order:
        result = subprocess.run(["taskset", "-c", "2", str(scratch / revision), "7", "timing"],
                                check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        assert not value["allocation_counting"] and not value["oracle"]
        for case, oracle in zip(value["cases"], oracles[revision]["cases"], strict=True):
            assert (case["kind"], case["words"], case["text_sha256"]) == (oracle["kind"], oracle["words"], oracle["text_sha256"])
            assert all(s["summary"] == oracle["samples"][0]["summary"] for s in case["samples"])
        raw.append({"pair": pair, "revision": revision, "data": value})
    print(f"timing pair {pair + 1}/5 complete", flush=True)
allocations = {}
for revision in ["baseline", "candidate"]:
    result = subprocess.run(["taskset", "-c", "2", str(scratch / (revision + "-allocation")), "3", "timing"],
                            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    value = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert value["allocation_counting"] and not value["oracle"]
    for case, oracle in zip(value["cases"], oracles[revision]["cases"], strict=True):
        assert (case["kind"], case["words"], case["text_sha256"]) == (oracle["kind"], oracle["words"], oracle["text_sha256"])
        assert all(s["summary"] == oracle["samples"][0]["summary"] for s in case["samples"])
    allocations[revision] = value
summaries = []
for index, case in enumerate(oracles["baseline"]["cases"]):
    row = {"kind": case["kind"], "words": case["words"], "oracle": case["oracle"], "phases": {}}
    for phase in ["analyze", "shape", "build"]:
        series = {rev: [sample[phase]["ns"] for run in raw if run["revision"] == rev
                        for sample in run["data"]["cases"][index]["samples"]]
                  for rev in ["baseline", "candidate"]}
        medians = {rev: statistics.median(ns) for rev, ns in series.items()}
        row["phases"][phase] = {"median_ns": medians,
                                 "change_percent": 100 * (medians["candidate"] / medians["baseline"] - 1),
                                 "allocation": {rev: allocations[rev]["cases"][index]["samples"][0][phase]["allocation"]
                                                for rev in ["baseline", "candidate"]}}
    summaries.append(row)
record = {"schema": "shodo-16-first-line-reuse-v1", "baseline": "c64b8b3c023ee6c527299ece83967bdf3c1011b2",
          "runtime_candidate": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(), "pairs": 5, "samples_per_process_case": 7,
          "cpu_affinity": [2], "machine": platform.platform(),
          "cpu": "AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics, 6 cores/12 threads; boost enabled",
          "toolchain": subprocess.check_output([os.path.expanduser("~/.cargo/bin/rustc"), "+stable", "-Vv"], text=True),
          "binary_sha256": {rev: hashlib.sha256((scratch / rev).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                            for rev in ["baseline", "candidate", "baseline-allocation", "candidate-allocation"]},
          "source": Path("dev/bench/examples/first_line_build_reuse.rs").read_text(),
          "compiled_baseline_measurement_source": Path("../shodo-16-base/dev/bench/examples/first_line_build_reuse.rs").read_text(),
          "snapshot_source": Path("dev/bench/examples/support/completed_height_snapshot.rs").read_text(),
          "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(), "oracles": oracles, "timing_processes": raw,
          "allocation_processes": allocations, "summary": summaries,
          "prior_guard_evaluation": json.loads((scratch / "prior-guard-evaluation.json").read_text())}
probe = scratch / "isolated-fallback-probe.json"
if probe.exists():
    record["isolated_fallback_probe"] = json.loads(probe.read_text())
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
for row in summaries:
    print(row["kind"], row["words"], {phase: round(cost["change_percent"], 1) for phase, cost in row["phases"].items()})
